import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    # Source 0: order-level info including order_status and order_approved_at
    df_orders = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype=str)
    # Source 1: order item-level info including product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value
    df_order_items = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={'order_id': str, 'order_item_id': str, 'product_id': str, 'seller_id': str, 'price': float, 'freight_value': float})
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_orders.head())
    # print(df_order_items.head())
    
    # Select and rename columns from source0 to match target schema
    # Target columns from source0: order_id, order_status, order_approved_at
    df_orders_sub = df_orders[['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at']].copy()
    
    # Select columns from source1 that match target schema: order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value
    df_order_items_sub = df_order_items[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']].copy()
    
    # Merge on order_id to combine order-level and item-level info
    # This is a many-to-one join: many items per order
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_order_items_sub, df_orders_sub, on='order_id', how='inner')
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = ['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Ensure data types match target schema
    df_target['order_id'] = df_target['order_id'].astype(str)
    df_target['order_status'] = df_target['order_status'].astype(str)
    df_target['order_approved_at'] = df_target['order_approved_at'].astype(str)
    df_target['product_id'] = df_target['product_id'].astype(str)
    df_target['seller_id'] = df_target['seller_id'].astype(str)
    df_target['price'] = df_target['price'].astype(float)
    df_target['freight_value'] = df_target['freight_value'].astype(float)
    
    # Write the result to the specified output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
